P08       .5487      .5487        79,240.61      175,577.95        a3d3ce15e150d05e
P10       .6785      .6785       194,036.31      603,565.29        7c4f1855794797d6
P11       .7099      .7099        27,582.48       95,077.98        d5af2d76e90bc408
P18       .4854      .4178        42,224.67       72,521.96        91033c7c228a8f00

Mean best composite 0.7265375; latest-per-case composite 0.7004299.
Latest P01/P03/P05/P07/P18 trail their recorded best. Do not infer latest code has
regressed from these unmatched runs: settings, wording, terms and versions vary.
All ten latest contracts meet must-haves and have zero uncovered-need cost. Thus
these latest gaps are not missing-volume coverage or invalid-contract failures.
For source files append CASE_SESSION.json to the sessions/practice directory.
Raw latest and best component data are in all_sessions.json, generated locally.

3. WHY LOWER UNIT PRICE CAN SCORE ZERO: OBSERVED P02 CONTRACTS

Good: 5918f12779f19f54, EUR371.88, payment90, fixed price; C=2,258,872.49;
score .5067. Bad: d52ccdd3d2e07b3f, EUR366.41, payment14, copper clause;
C=2,304,040.67 > C_open=2,282,867.49, hence score clipped to zero.
Both meet must-haves. The lower price was real but the overall package was worse.

Bad minus good component deltas, EUR:
price              -33,421.70
payment             +38,033.06
index adjustment    +22,387.65
index risk          +17,910.12
relationship           +259.05
net                 +45,168.18

Another observed EUR368.70/payment90/copper deal scored zero too: the clause and
risk cost EUR40,549.63; relationship charge EUR5,482.57. Current P02 relationship
charge is only EUR642.15, so removing that charge alone cannot close EUR23,358 gap.

4. P08 AND P18: CURRENT ECONOMICS AND BOUNDED COUNTERFACTUALS

P08 latest: EUR5.35, payment90, 36months, AS-14404 clause. Price spend1,014,360;
payment credit -6,762.40; index adjustment27,387.72; risk4,564.62; C1,039,549.94.
Benchmark960,309.33. Gap79,240.61 (7.623% of deal C).
P18 latest: EUR5.40, payment45, 36months, same clause. Price spend255,960;
payment853.20; index6,910.92; risk1,151.82; C264,875.94.
Benchmark222,651.27. Gap42,224.67 (15.941% of deal C).
P18 best observed was EUR5.30/payment45/24months, score .4854, gap37,319.56.

The following are official-cost arithmetic at UNCHANGED price and other terms,
not evidence the supplier would accept them:
- P08 remove index clause: save31,952.34, score .7307, still 47,288.27 above benchmark.
- P18 remove clause: save8,062.74, score .5289, still 34,161.93 above benchmark.
- P18 payment45 to90: save2,559.60, score .4531. Supplier may demand a price premium.
- 36 to24months changes no direct cost in either case: horizon is two years.
- 36 to12months worsens C by38,748.71(P08) /17,201.46(P18) at the same price,
  because uncovered second-year need goes to the fallback. A shorter fixed-price
  contract is not automatically an improvement.

Holding the accepted package fixed, the algebraic unit prices for C_best are
about4.94219(P08) and4.53917(P18). These are diagnostic numbers, not demonstrated
reservation prices or acceptable offers. Do not present them as attainable targets.

A one-cent price reduction saves1,943.08 on P08, adding1.1067 percentage points to
case score (0.1107 team points). One cent on P18 saves490.51, adding0.6764 case
percentage points (0.0676 team points). P08 already has max allowed payment90.
P18's remaining credit lever is modest versus its full gap. Repricing for changed
payment and index terms must be included before recommending any trade.

5. MORE AGGRESSION: WHERE THE OBSERVATIONS SUPPORT A TEST

Broadly lower anchors are not supported. Latest P08/P18 already opened at4.76/4.77
against quotes6.05/6.10 (raw-price comparisons, not equivalent-package discounts).
They reached final_offer at round3, with supplier paths5.43->5.38->5.35 and
5.50->5.40->5.40. Seven unused message slots do not establish seven safe concessions.
Both explicitly refused fixed pricing over the requested long contract. They cited
material volatility and declining further price movement. An additional price-only
push could simply withdraw the offer; the logs do not establish counterfactual gain.

P02 provides observed downside: session b85685a51d797c60 opened344.14/payment90,
then353.06,359.03,362.93. Supplier withdrew in round4. The later351.23 opening plus
faster approach to its quote reached371.88 and .5067. Multiple parameters differ,
so this is risk evidence, not a causal estimate of the better anchor.

A narrower hypothesis is justified for P05: latest selected Dralveck fell36.00 to
30.50 in round1, then immediately agreed to OUR28.07 offer in round2. That is a
plausible early-overconcession signal. The best observed P05 contract was27.86,
score.8280, versus latest28.07/.8063. Test a smaller second concession or a bounded
hold after a deep first concession, keeping the package and claims constant. Do not
assume agreement at an even lower price. Scope to suppliers that show this pattern,
retain final-offer and time guards, compare paired total costs and no-deal rates.

P07 is another controlled-experiment candidate: latest offers5.31->5.48->5.49
(payment60) ended agreed at5.49 round3, whereas its best4.72->5.10->5.20 path
(payment45) ended at5.35 and .7510. Because payment differs, this is not proof that
a deeper anchor caused the gain. First compare matched payment/package paths.

For P08/P18 prioritize evidence-backed package/argument changes over squeezing
more rounds from final_offer. Latest P18 requested supporting volume data; current
reader/attachment changes could answer that request, but their benefit requires
prospective evaluation. Avoid equating a supplier's prose claim with a verified
constraint; use it as evidence and compare against structured replies.

6. RECOMMENDED EVALUATION

Keep the corrected financial and deadline guards. Evaluate one strategy change at
a time on matching cases and terms, first offline/sandbox. Proposed first experiment:
P05-style deep-concession supplier, smaller second move versus baseline, same claims,
payment, delivery and initial anchor. Report every trial: mean and worst score/cost,
valid agreements, walkaways, must-have failures, deadline misses. Do not promote by
leaderboard best-of-run composites. Hidden C_best is allowed only in retrospective
practice analysis, never in decision-time features or final cross-session tuning.

# AGENTS.md

Rules for AI coding agents in this repo. Humans follow them too.

Hackathon repo, EHL Grand Finale, Munich, 10 to 11 Oct 2026. Code freeze and Live Final Sunday
12:00. Working agent first, polish second.

## Rules

- Do not preserve backward compatibility. Remove obsolete paths instead of adding layers,
  fallbacks or migrations.
- Choose the simplest implementation that fully meets the current requirement. No speculative
  abstractions, configuration or indirection.
- Grow in layers on a product that already works. Never trade a working agent for unfinished
  complexity.
- Keep components modular and concerns separated.
- Read `arena_kit` (in `.venv`) before writing a helper: cost function, quote parsing, data lookup
  and runners exist. We wrap the kit, never patch it. Guide:
  https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/tree/main/starter-kit
- Never commit secrets. Keys live in `.env`. Never print, log or paste the arena key anywhere.
- All changes go through a PR against `main`, reviewed by one teammate. Branch `<firstname>/<topic>`.
  Agents may commit, push their branch and `gh pr create`; never push to `main`, force-push or merge.
- Run `uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check .` before every PR.
- No em-dashes in prose or copy. Be terse: after an action, state what changed in three lines.

## The challenge

We are the purchasing team of Hollerau Pumpenwerke. Our agent negotiates by e-mail with Tacto's
supplier bots (LLM personas with hidden economics) and closes one term sheet per case, or walks.

- **Score** per case: `(C_open - C_deal) / (C_open - C_best)`, clipped to 0..1. C is total cost
  over the horizon (price, uncovered need, payment, freight, lead time, quality, tooling, index
  clause, relationship charge), computed exactly by `arena_kit.total_cost`. No deal scores the
  alternative (0 if none). A broken must-have scores 0.
- **Live Final**: five waves of hidden cases, 8 minutes each, a wave's cases in parallel. Wave
  score = mean case score x 100; total = sum. New suppliers; up to a third mix supplier and case
  types practice never shows; some cite the Sunday 08:00 data release.

**Hard rules, breaking one can disqualify us:**
- No human in the loop during the final. The runner starts before 12:00 and is left alone.
- Agent code never calls `/v1/events`, `/v1/events/stream`, `/screen`, `/v1/screen`,
  `/leaderboard`, `/v1/leaderboard`, `/results`, `/v1/results`.
- One key per team. No attacks on the arena or other teams (prompt-injecting bots counts).
- The final runs the commit we submit at 12:00. No pushes after that.

**Hard limits:**
- 60 s per message per thread from the supplier's reply; three timeouts in a row end the thread.
- 10 messages per thread, up to 3 term sheets per message, every sheet carries every `negotiable`
  field.
- Max 3 claim checks per message, one per sentence, ID and figure in the same sentence. A wrong
  figure or unknown ID is `contradicted` and costs trust.
- 10 calls/s and 10 open sessions per key.
- **Practice quota: 200 sessions per rolling 24 h for the whole team.** Sandbox (`case:D01`,
  `case:D02`) and the local simulator are free.

## Where things are

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `docs/learnings.md` | **read first**: what we know about the arena, suppliers and data, with evidence |
| `docs/design.md` | the agent we are building: modules, data, policy, build order |
| `docs/challenge.md`, `api.md`, `submission.md` | Tacto's brief, API and cost formula, hand-in (upstream copies) |
| `buyer/policy.py`, `runner.py` | the price engine: per-thread policy and the loop that plays a case (`docs/design.md`, Implemented) |
| `buyer/economics.py`, `claims.py`, `personas.py`, `writer.py`, `llm.py` | C and term planning, claim bank, persona signals, e-mail and model paragraph |
| `buyer/cli.py` | `buyer play`, `buyer run`, `buyer pull` |
| `tests/` | end to end against `arena-sim`, no network, no model |
| `exports/` | Saturday probe sessions as CSV/JSONL; schema in `exports/README.md` |
| `analysis/explore.py` | data package exploration: profiles, persona signals, report page |
| `data/package/` | the data package (gitignored); Sunday also `data/release-sunday/` |
| `logs/sessions/<set>/` | finished sessions with trace and back office (gitignored; Saturday's committed with `-f`) |
| `logs/runs/`, `logs/practice-v*.log` | our decisions per move (anchor, terms, claims, prices) and the practice run logs |

The MCP server `arena-data` (`.mcp.json`) gives SQL, ID lookup and documents over the package.

## Commands

```sh
uv sync                                         # install (Python 3.12)
uv run arena data                               # data package into data/
uv run arena me                                 # key works? quota left?
uv run buyer play case:D01 -v                   # sandbox: free
uv run buyer play case:P01 -v                   # practice: costs 1 of the team's 200
uv run buyer run --set practice --parallel 10   # all hosted practice cases: costs 10
uv run buyer pull --set practice                # finished sessions -> logs/sessions/
uv run arena-sim serve --no-clock --data data/package   # local API, scripted supplier
uv run --with pandas python analysis/explore.py # data package -> analysis/out/
```

`--agent naive` plays the kit's baseline instead of ours.

## Working on the negotiation agent

- **Code owns numbers, the model owns words.** Every binding value (sheet, accept, walk away) is
  computed or checked in code with `total_cost` and `must_haves_ok`; every figure in an e-mail
  comes from code next to its data ID.
- **Never accept** a sheet that breaks a must-have or costs more than the alternative. Price
  unstated fields at the supplier's standard terms (`arena_kit.docs.standard_terms`).

        ids = self.bank.ids(f"sc:{sid.split(':')[-1]}@")

        the thread, so the next move continues the path instead of opening at the anchor again."""
        s = self.sides[sid]

Simulator scores are plumbing diagnostics, not estimates of hosted performance.
No API credentials, remote sessions or language-model calls are used.
"""

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib
import importlib.util
import json
import logging
import math
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

from arena_kit.client import ArenaError
from arena_kit.cost import must_haves_ok
from arena_kit.data import DataPackage
from arena_kit.sim import Fail, Sim, load_cases

SCENARIOS = (
    "original",
    "interest_20pct",
    "freight_x3",

    "impossible_must_have",

    "one_message",
)


def load_buyer(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        name, path / "buyer/__init__.py", submodule_search_locations=[str(path / "buyer")]
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return importlib.import_module(f"{name}.runner"), importlib.import_module(f"{name}.policy")


class LocalClient:
    """Transport adapter only: all negotiation and scoring behavior stays in official Sim."""

    def __init__(self, case, facts):
        self.sim = Sim({case["case_id"]: copy.deepcopy(case)}, facts=facts, clock=lambda: 1_000_000.0)
        self.sent = []
        self.case = case
        self.proposal_violations = []

    def call(self, method, *args):
        try:
            return copy.deepcopy(method("local", *args))
        except Fail as exc:
            raise ArenaError(exc.status, exc.detail) from None

    def open_session(self, case_id):
        return self.call(self.sim.open, case_id)

    def send_message(self, session_id, supplier_id, message):
        self.sent.append(copy.deepcopy({"supplier": supplier_id, "message": message}))
        for sheet in message.get("term_sheets") or []:
            terms = sheet["terms"]
            std = self.sim.sessions[session_id]["threads"][supplier_id]["standard"]
            if not must_haves_ok(self.case, terms, std):
                self.proposal_violations.append({"supplier": supplier_id, "terms": terms, "reason": "must_haves"})
        return self.call(self.sim.message, session_id, supplier_id, message)

    def attachment(self, session_id, attachment_id):
        return self.call(self.sim.attachment, session_id, attachment_id)[0]

    def session(self, session_id):
        return self.call(self.sim.state, session_id)

    def thread(self, session_id, supplier_id):
        return self.call(self.sim.thread, session_id, supplier_id)


def change(case, scenario):
    case = copy.deepcopy(case)
    b = case["buyer"]
    if scenario == "interest_20pct":
        b["interest_rate"] = 0.20
    elif scenario == "freight_x3":
        b["freight_eur_per_unit"] = {k: 3 * v for k, v in b["freight_eur_per_unit"].items()}
    elif scenario == "delivery_penalty_x3":
        b["late_cost_per_day"] = 3 * b.get("late_cost_per_day", 0)
    elif scenario == "quality_cost_x3":
        b["cost_per_defect"] = 3 * b.get("cost_per_defect", 0)
    elif scenario == "relationship_charge_x3":
        b["relationship_eur_per_point"] = 3 * b.get("relationship_eur_per_point", 0)
    elif scenario == "longer_horizon":
        b["horizon_years"] += 1
    elif scenario == "payment_floor_60":
        b["must_haves"] = [*b.get("must_haves", []), {"field": "payment_days", "op": ">=", "value": 60}]
    elif scenario == "impossible_must_have":
        b["must_haves"] = [*b.get("must_haves", []), {"field": "payment_days", "op": ">=", "value": 1000}]
    elif scenario == "strong_alternative":
        terms = {
            **case.get("fixed_terms", {}),
            "unit_price": round(0.85 * (b.get("current_unit_price") or b["fallback_unit_price"]), 2),
            "payment_days": b["reference_payment_days"],
            "contract_months": int(b["horizon_years"] * 12),
            "volume_per_year": b["need_per_year"],

            "incoterm": min(b["freight_eur_per_unit"], key=b["freight_eur_per_unit"].get),

    elif scenario in ("two_messages", "one_message"):
        case["round_limit"] = 2 if scenario == "two_messages" else 1

    started = time.perf_counter()
    row = {"case": case["case_id"], "variant": label, "scenario": scenario, "data_mode": mode}

        row["accepted_worse_than_alternative"] = bool(

        row["error"] = None

        row["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"

Simulator scores are plumbing diagnostics, not estimates of hosted performance.
No API credentials, remote sessions or language-model calls are used.
"""

import argparse
import copy
import hashlib
import importlib
import importlib.util
import json
import logging
import math
import statistics
import sys

from arena_kit.client import ArenaError
from arena_kit.cost import must_haves_ok
from arena_kit.data import DataPackage
from arena_kit.sim import Fail, Sim, load_cases

SCENARIOS = (
    "original",
    "interest_20pct",
    "freight_x3",
    "delivery_penalty_x3",
    "quality_cost_x3",
    "relationship_charge_x3",
    "longer_horizon",
    "payment_floor_60",
    "strong_alternative",
    "impossible_must_have",
    "two_messages",
    "one_message",
)


def load_buyer(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(
        name, path / "buyer/__init__.py", submodule_search_locations=[str(path / "buyer")]
    )
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return importlib.import_module(f"{name}.runner"), importlib.import_module(f"{name}.policy")


class LocalClient:
    """Transport adapter only: all negotiation and scoring behavior stays in official Sim."""

    def __init__(self, case, facts):
        self.sim = Sim({case["case_id"]: copy.deepcopy(case)}, facts=facts, clock=lambda: 1_000_000.0)
        self.sent = []
        self.case = case
        self.proposal_violations = []

    def call(self, method, *args):
        try:
            return copy.deepcopy(method("local", *args))
        except Fail as exc:
            raise ArenaError(exc.status, exc.detail) from None

    def open_session(self, case_id):
        return self.call(self.sim.open, case_id)

    def send_message(self, session_id, supplier_id, message):
        self.sent.append(copy.deepcopy({"supplier": supplier_id, "message": message}))
        for sheet in message.get("term_sheets") or []:
            terms = sheet["terms"]
            std = self.sim.sessions[session_id]["threads"][supplier_id]["standard"]
            if not must_haves_ok(self.case, terms, std):
                self.proposal_violations.append({"supplier": supplier_id, "terms": terms, "reason": "must_haves"})
        return self.call(self.sim.message, session_id, supplier_id, message)

    def attachment(self, session_id, attachment_id):
        return self.call(self.sim.attachment, session_id, attachment_id)[0]

    def session(self, session_id):
        return self.call(self.sim.state, session_id)

    def thread(self, session_id, supplier_id):
        return self.call(self.sim.thread, session_id, supplier_id)


def change(case, scenario):
    case = copy.deepcopy(case)
    b = case["buyer"]
    if scenario == "interest_20pct":
        b["interest_rate"] = 0.20
    elif scenario == "freight_x3":
        b["freight_eur_per_unit"] = {k: 3 * v for k, v in b["freight_eur_per_unit"].items()}
    elif scenario == "delivery_penalty_x3":
        b["late_cost_per_day"] = 3 * b.get("late_cost_per_day", 0)
    elif scenario == "quality_cost_x3":
        b["cost_per_defect"] = 3 * b.get("cost_per_defect", 0)
    elif scenario == "relationship_charge_x3":
        b["relationship_eur_per_point"] = 3 * b.get("relationship_eur_per_point", 0)
    elif scenario == "longer_horizon":
        b["horizon_years"] += 1
    elif scenario == "payment_floor_60":
        b["must_haves"] = [*b.get("must_haves", []), {"field": "payment_days", "op": ">=", "value": 60}]
    elif scenario == "impossible_must_have":
        b["must_haves"] = [*b.get("must_haves", []), {"field": "payment_days", "op": ">=", "value": 1000}]
    elif scenario == "strong_alternative":
        terms = {
            **case.get("fixed_terms", {}),
            "unit_price": round(0.85 * (b.get("current_unit_price") or b["fallback_unit_price"]), 2),
            "payment_days": b["reference_payment_days"],
            "contract_months": int(b["horizon_years"] * 12),
            "volume_per_year": b["need_per_year"],
            "lead_time_days": b["need_lead_time_days"],
            "incoterm": min(b["freight_eur_per_unit"], key=b["freight_eur_per_unit"].get),

    elif scenario in ("two_messages", "one_message"):

def run(case, runner, policy, pkg, label, scenario, mode, out):
    client = LocalClient(case, pkg.facts if pkg else {})
    table = runner.RemoteTable(client)
    runner.RUNS = out.parent / "decisions" / label / mode / scenario
    started = time.perf_counter()
    row = {"case": case["case_id"], "variant": label, "scenario": scenario, "data_mode": mode}
    try:
        result = runner.play_case(table, case["case_id"], pkg, complete=None)
        state = client.session(table.session_id)
        row.update(
            {k: result.get(k) for k in ("deal", "score", "c_deal", "c_alt", "end_reason", "terms", "supplier_id")}
        )
        row["must_haves_ok"] = result.get("must_haves_ok")
        row["accepted_worse_than_alternative"] = bool(
            result.get("deal") and result.get("c_alt") is not None and result["c_deal"] > result["c_alt"] + 0.01
        )
        row["trace"] = state["result"].get("trace", [])
        row["error"] = None
    except Exception as exc:
        row["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
    row["runtime_s"] = round(time.perf_counter() - started, 4)
    row["proposal_violations"] = client.proposal_violations
    row["messages"] = len(client.sent)
    row["accepted_invalid"] = bool(row.get("deal") and row.get("terms") and not must_haves_ok(case, row["terms"]))
    (out / f"{label}_{mode}_{scenario}_{case['case_id'].split(':')[-1]}.json").write_text(

    )

def test_infeasible_low_anchor_tries_safe_relationship_target_before_closing():
    case, sid = fixture()
    case["buyer"].update(category_goal="stabilise", relationship_eur_per_point=10000, sustainable_margin_pct=8)
    case["buyer"]["alternative"] = {"kind": "quote", "terms": {"unit_price": 16, "payment_days": 60}}
    case["facts"] = {"cost:own": {"part": case["parts"][0], "unit_cost": 14, "supplier": sid}}
    events = [message([sheet(17, 60, "initial")])]
    neg = Negotiator(case)
    side = neg.setup(sid, events)
    low = {**side.terms, "unit_price": 10}
    assert not neg.valid_proposal(side, low)
    assert side.target is not None
    move = neg.send(side, [low], [], events, 17)
    assert move is not None
    proposed = move["message"]["term_sheets"][0]["terms"]
    assert proposed == {**low, "unit_price": side.target}
    assert neg.valid_proposal(side, proposed)
    assert eco.cost(case, proposed, side.std, side.est) < eco.cost(case, side.last_sheet, side.std, side.est)
    neg.commit(sid)
    # This repair is only for the initial anchor, not an arbitrary later invalid proposal.
    assert neg.send(side, [low], [], events, 17) is None


def test_relationship_target_cannot_repair_infeasible_nonprice_term():
    case, sid = fixture()
    case["buyer"].update(category_goal="stabilise", relationship_eur_per_point=10000, sustainable_margin_pct=8)
    case["buyer"]["must_haves"] = [{"field": "payment_days", "op": ">=", "value": 30}]
    case["facts"] = {"cost:own": {"part": case["parts"][0], "unit_cost": 14, "supplier": sid}}
    events = [message([sheet(17, 60, "initial")])]
    neg = Negotiator(case)
    side = neg.setup(sid, events)
    assert side.target is not None
    assert neg.send(side, [{"unit_price": 10, "payment_days": 14}], [], events, 17) is None
    assert side.ours == []

"""Replay recorded terminal offers through candidate guards, with explicit coverage limits."""
import json
import math
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

from arena_kit import must_haves_ok, total_cost
from buyer.policy import Negotiator, Side

OUT = Path('/private/tmp/pr12-local-replay/report.json')
cases = {}

    cases.update({c['case_id']:c for c in json.loads(p.read_text())})

standards = {}
for p in (ROOT/'logs/runs').glob('*.json'):
    run = json.loads(p.read_text())
    for n in run.get('notes',[]):
        if n.get('what')=='setup' and 'std' in n:
            standards[(run['session'],n['supplier'])]=(n['std'],str(p.relative_to(ROOT)))
for line in (ROOT/'exports/threads.jsonl').read_text().splitlines():
    row=json.loads(line)
    key=(row['session_id'],row['supplier_id'])
    if key not in standards and row.get('standard_terms'):
        standards[key]=(json.loads(row['standard_terms']),'exports/threads.jsonl')


def event_from_trace(t):
    m=t['move']
    if t['actor']=='buyer':
        return {'from':'buyer',**m}
    sheets=[]
    if m.get('offer_id') and m.get('terms'):
        sheets=[{'term_sheet_id':m['offer_id'],'terms':m['terms']}]
    sheets += [{'term_sheet_id':a['offer_id'],'terms':a['terms']} for a in m.get('alternatives',[])]
    return {'from':t['actor'],'status':m.get('status'),'body':m.get('text',''),'term_sheets':sheets}


rows=[]
for p in sorted((ROOT/'logs/sessions').glob('*/*.json')):
    raw=json.loads(p.read_text())
    if raw['set'] not in ('practice','sandbox'):
        continue
    case=cases[raw['case_id']]
    threads={}
    for i,t in enumerate(raw['result']['trace']):
        if t['actor']!='buyer':
            threads[t['actor']]=[event_from_trace(t)]
    neg=Negotiator(case)
    source_rows=[]
    for sid,events in threads.items():
        side=Side(sid)
        saved=standards.get((raw['session_id'],sid))
        side.std=saved[0] if saved else {}
        neg.sides[sid]=side
        source_rows.append({'supplier_id':sid,'standard_source':saved[1] if saved else None,
                            'standard_terms':saved[0] if saved else None,
                            'last_status':events[-1]['status']})
    # Unknown supplier economics are deliberately not fabricated. Model-check uses no
    # relationship estimate and is NOT an exact-economic verdict for these cases.
    alt=case['buyer'].get('alternative') or {}
    alt_cost=total_cost(case,alt['terms']) if alt.get('terms',{}).get('unit_price') else math.inf
    expected=[]
    for sid,events in threads.items():
        last=events[-1]
        if last['status'] in ('walked_away','no_bid') or not last['term_sheets']:
            continue
        sheet=last['term_sheets'][0]
        terms=sheet['terms']
        std=neg.sides[sid].std
        if terms.get('unit_price') and must_haves_ok(case,terms,std):
            cost=total_cost(case,terms,std)

    cheapest=min((x[0] for x in expected),default=None)
    actual=neg.best_offer(threads)
    assert (actual is None)==(cheapest is None),raw['session_id']
    if actual:

    unknown=[s['supplier_id'] for s in source_rows if s['standard_source'] is None
             and s['last_status'] not in ('walked_away','no_bid')]
    relationship=bool(case['buyer'].get('relationship_eur_per_point'))
    rows.append({
        'session_id':raw['session_id'],'case_id':raw['case_id'],'environment':raw['set'],
        'source':str(p.relative_to(ROOT)),'recorded_score':raw['result']['score'],
        'recorded_deal':raw['result']['deal'],'candidate_terminal_selection':actual,
        'same_assumptions_guard_check':'passed','missing_standard_suppliers':unknown,
        'relationship_economics_unknown':relationship,
        'complete_public_economics':not unknown and not relationship,
        'supplier_standards':source_rows,
    })

# Specific historical loss: do not raise a supplier's 27.86 agreed sheet to 28.07.
p=ROOT/'logs/sessions/practice/P05_8c829c180671cc22.json'
raw=json.loads(p.read_text());sid='sup:70210'
trace=raw['result']['trace']
events=[event_from_trace(t) for t in trace[:13]
        if t['actor']==sid or (t['actor']=='buyer' and t['move'].get('supplier_id')==sid)]

side=neg.setup(sid,[events[0]])
side.std=standards[(raw['session_id'],sid)][0]
side.terms=trace[3]['move']['term_sheets'][0]['terms'].copy()
side.ours=[27.86];side.theirs=[30.5];side.last_sheet=trace[4]['move']['terms']
move=neg.move(sid,{sid:events})
assert move is None,move
best=neg.best_offer({sid:events})
assert best[2]==trace[12]['move']['offer_id']
assert best[0]==237545.21,best

summary={
    'sessions':len(rows),'same_assumptions_guard_checks_passed':len(rows),
    'complete_public_economics_sessions':sum(r['complete_public_economics'] for r in rows),
    'missing_standard_sessions':sum(bool(r['missing_standard_suppliers']) for r in rows),
    'relationship_unknown_sessions':sum(r['relationship_economics_unknown'] for r in rows),
    'environments':dict(Counter(r['environment'] for r in rows)),
    'p05_agreed_no_increase_regression':{'passed':True,'session_id':raw['session_id'],
        'trace_index':12,'preserved_cost':best[0],'historical_final_cost':raw['result']['c_deal']},
}
report={'summary':summary,'limitations':[
    'These are guard replays on recorded supplier offers, not simulated new supplier responses or score predictions.',
    'Only each thread latest standing offer is eligible; earlier quotes and latest alternatives cannot be accepted.',
    'Standards from recorded run setup or historical thread exports only; unavailable standards explicitly marked.',
    'Missing standards use kit defaults for mechanical check only, not exact economic validation.',
    'Hidden relationship economics unavailable: zero-estimate model check is not true-cost certification.',
    'Terminal offers are evaluated as an isolated pre-close snapshot; original ended sessions cannot reopen.',

OUT.write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))

a rising index or a should-cost above the quote would argue the supplier's case.

In the sandbox the case's refs point into a demo world our package does not hold: those are cited
without a figure, so the arena checks them against their own value."""

import re

ID_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:idx|quote|offer|sc|qn|po|cost|fc|news|doc|ctr):[\w.:@#/-]*\w")
SERIES_NAME = {
    "PPI-C2451": "Producer prices for iron castings",

    "PPI-D351": "Electricity producer prices",

    "LCI-C": "Manufacturing labour costs",
    "WB-CU": "Copper",
    "WB-NI": "Nickel",
    "WB-AL": "Aluminium",
    "WB-NGEU": "European natural gas",
    "CU-NOTATION": "The copper notation",
    "AS-14404": "The 1.4404 alloy surcharge",
    "AS-14301": "The 1.4301 alloy surcharge",
}


def months_back(month, n):
    y, m = (int(x) for x in month.split("-"))
    m -= n
    while m <= 0:
        m, y = m + 12, y - 1
    return f"{y}-{m:02d}"


def money(x):
    return f"EUR {x:.2f}"


def per_unit(fact):
    """Pieces a recorded price covers: 15 of 108 quotes and some orders are priced per 100 or 1000."""
    try:
        return int(fact.get("price_unit") or 1) or 1
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 1


class ClaimBank:
    """Arguments for one case. `pkg` is the data package (or None); the case's own `facts` win."""

    def __init__(self, pkg, case):
        self.pkg, self.case = pkg, case
        self.facts = case.get("facts") or {}
        self.refs = list(case.get("refs") or [])
        # a case whose refs the package does not know (the sandbox's demo world)
        self.foreign = bool(self.refs) and pkg is not None and not any(pkg.lookup(r) for r in self.refs)

    def fact(self, ref):
        if ref in self.facts:
            return self.facts[ref]
        return None if self.foreign or self.pkg is None else self.pkg.lookup(ref)

    def ids(self, prefix):
        out = set() if self.foreign or self.pkg is None else set(self.pkg.ids(prefix))
        out |= {k for k in self.facts if k.startswith(prefix)}
        out |= {r for r in self.refs if r.startswith(prefix)}
        return sorted(out)

    def query(self, sql, params=()):
        if self.foreign or self.pkg is None:
            return []
        try:
            return self.pkg.query(sql, params)

checks them (`docs/api.md`, What counts). Only arguments that push the price our way are kept;
a rising index or a should-cost above the quote would argue the supplier's case.

In the sandbox the case's refs point into a demo world our package does not hold: those are cited
without a figure, so the arena checks them against their own value."""

import re

ID_RE = re.compile(r"\b(?:idx|quote|offer|sc|qn|po|cost|fc|news|doc|ctr):[\w.:@#/-]*\w")
SERIES_NAME = {
    "PPI-C2451": "Producer prices for iron castings",
    "PPI-C2452": "Producer prices for steel castings",
    "PPI-C2562": "Producer prices for machining",
    "PPI-C2594": "Producer prices for fasteners",

    "PPI-C241": "Producer prices for basic iron and steel",
    "PPI-C2431": "Producer prices for cold-drawn bars",
    "PPI-C2219": "Producer prices for rubber products",
    "PPI-D351": "Electricity producer prices",

    "LCI-C": "Manufacturing labour costs",
    "WB-CU": "Copper",
    "WB-NI": "Nickel",
    "WB-AL": "Aluminium",
    "WB-NGEU": "European natural gas",
    "CU-NOTATION": "The copper notation",
    "AS-14404": "The 1.4404 alloy surcharge",
    "AS-14301": "The 1.4301 alloy surcharge",
}


def months_back(month, n):
    y, m = (int(x) for x in month.split("-"))
    m -= n
    while m <= 0:
        m, y = m + 12, y - 1
    return f"{y}-{m:02d}"


def money(x):
    return f"EUR {x:.2f}"


def per_unit(fact):
    """Pieces a recorded price covers: 15 of 108 quotes and some orders are priced per 100 or 1000."""
    try:
        return int(fact.get("price_unit") or 1) or 1
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return 1


class ClaimBank:
    """Arguments for one case. `pkg` is the data package (or None); the case's own `facts` win."""

    def __init__(self, pkg, case):
        self.pkg, self.case = pkg, case
        self.facts = case.get("facts") or {}
        self.refs = list(case.get("refs") or [])
        # a case whose refs the package does not know (the sandbox's demo world)
        self.foreign = bool(self.refs) and pkg is not None and not any(pkg.lookup(r) for r in self.refs)

    def fact(self, ref):
        if ref in self.facts:
            return self.facts[ref]
        return None if self.foreign or self.pkg is None else self.pkg.lookup(ref)

    def ids(self, prefix):
        out = set() if self.foreign or self.pkg is None else set(self.pkg.ids(prefix))
        out |= {k for k in self.facts if k.startswith(prefix)}
        out |= {r for r in self.refs if r.startswith(prefix)}
        return sorted(out)

    def query(self, sql, params=()):
        if self.foreign or self.pkg is None:
            return []
        try:
            return self.pkg.query(sql, params)

"""Offline replay isolation, snapshot selection and action checks."""

import copy
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

from arena_kit.sim import load_cases

from buyer import policy

SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("replay", Path(__file__).parents[1] / "scripts/replay_latest_practice.py")
replay = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(replay)


def fixture():
    case = copy.deepcopy(load_cases()["case:S01"])
    sid = case["suppliers"][0]
    trace = [
        {"actor": sid, "round": 0, "move": {"offer_id": "offer:0", "status": "open",
         "terms": {"unit_price": 17, "payment_days": 60}, "text": "Our quote."}},
        {"actor": "buyer", "round": 1, "move": {"type": "message", "supplier_id": sid,
         "term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": 14, "payment_days": 60}}], "refs": []}},
        {"actor": sid, "round": 1, "move": {"offer_id": "offer:1", "status": "final_offer",
         "terms": {"unit_price": 15, "payment_days": 60}, "text": "Our final offer."}},
    ]
    return case, {"session_id": "fixture", "case_id": case["case_id"], "result": {"trace": trace}}


def test_latest_completed_selection_uses_timestamp_then_id_excludes_open():
    rows = [{"session_id": "z", "created_at": 1, "status": "ended"},
            {"session_id": "a", "created_at": 1, "status": "ended"},
            {"session_id": "new", "created_at": 3, "status": "open"}]
    assert [r["session_id"] for r in replay.completed_catalog(rows)] == ["a", "z"]


def test_public_event_drops_hidden_reason_and_cost_fields():
    case, raw = fixture()
    row = raw["result"]["trace"][0]
    row["reasons"] = ["hidden private reasoning"]
    row["move"]["c_best"] = -999
    event = replay.event_from_trace(row)
    assert "reasons" not in event and "c_best" not in event
    assert "hidden" not in str(event)


def test_future_outcome_and_replies_do_not_change_earlier_replay():
    case, raw = fixture()
    original = replay.replay_session(raw, case, policy)
    altered = copy.deepcopy(raw)
    altered["result"].update(score=1, c_best=-999, terms={"unit_price": .01})
    altered["backoffice"] = [{"text": "hidden floor"}]
    altered["result"]["trace"][-1]["move"]["terms"]["unit_price"] = 19
    changed = replay.replay_session(altered, case, policy)
    assert original["prefixes"][0] == changed["prefixes"][0]
    assert len(original["prefixes"]) == 2
    assert not any(r["failures"] for r in original["prefixes"])


def test_checker_detects_an_invalid_candidate_package(monkeypatch):
    case, raw = fixture()
    case["buyer"]["must_haves"] = [{"field": "payment_days", "op": ">=", "value": 30}]
    monkeypatch.setattr(policy.Negotiator, "move", lambda *a, **k: {
        "message": {"term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": 10, "payment_days": 14}}]}})
    checked = replay.replay_session(raw, case, policy)
    assert "unsafe_proposed_package" in checked["prefixes"][0]["failures"]
    assert "terminal_reply_renegotiated_instead_of_mirroring" in checked["prefixes"][-1]["failures"]


def test_checker_detects_claim_citing_future_offer(monkeypatch):
    case, raw = fixture()
    monkeypatch.setattr(policy.Negotiator, "move", lambda *a, **k: {
        "message": {"term_sheets": [], "refs": ["offer:1"]}})
    checked = replay.replay_session(raw, case, policy)
    assert "claim_references_unseen_offer" in checked["prefixes"][0]["failures"]
    assert "claim_references_unseen_offer" not in checked["prefixes"][-1]["failures"]

"""Offline replay isolation, snapshot selection and action checks."""

import copy
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

from arena_kit.sim import load_cases

from buyer import policy

SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("replay", Path(__file__).parents[1] / "scripts/replay_latest_practice.py")
replay = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
SPEC.loader.exec_module(replay)


def fixture():
    case = copy.deepcopy(load_cases()["case:S01"])
    sid = case["suppliers"][0]
    trace = [
        {"actor": sid, "round": 0, "move": {"offer_id": "offer:0", "status": "open",
         "terms": {"unit_price": 17, "payment_days": 60}, "text": "Our quote."}},
        {"actor": "buyer", "round": 1, "move": {"type": "message", "supplier_id": sid,
         "term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": 14, "payment_days": 60}}], "refs": []}},
        {"actor": sid, "round": 1, "move": {"offer_id": "offer:1", "status": "final_offer",
         "terms": {"unit_price": 15, "payment_days": 60}, "text": "Our final offer."}},
    ]
    return case, {"session_id": "fixture", "case_id": case["case_id"], "result": {"trace": trace}}


def test_latest_completed_selection_uses_timestamp_then_id_excludes_open():
    rows = [{"session_id": "z", "created_at": 1, "status": "ended"},
            {"session_id": "a", "created_at": 1, "status": "ended"},
            {"session_id": "new", "created_at": 3, "status": "open"}]
    assert [r["session_id"] for r in replay.completed_catalog(rows)] == ["a", "z"]


def test_public_event_drops_hidden_reason_and_cost_fields():
    case, raw = fixture()
    row = raw["result"]["trace"][0]
    row["reasons"] = ["hidden private reasoning"]
    row["move"]["c_best"] = -999
    event = replay.event_from_trace(row)
    assert "reasons" not in event and "c_best" not in event
    assert "hidden" not in str(event)


def test_future_outcome_and_replies_do_not_change_earlier_replay():
    case, raw = fixture()
    original = replay.replay_session(raw, case, policy)
    altered = copy.deepcopy(raw)
    altered["result"].update(score=1, c_best=-999, terms={"unit_price": .01})
    altered["backoffice"] = [{"text": "hidden floor"}]
    altered["result"]["trace"][-1]["move"]["terms"]["unit_price"] = 19
    changed = replay.replay_session(altered, case, policy)
    assert original["prefixes"][0] == changed["prefixes"][0]
    assert len(original["prefixes"]) == 2
    assert not any(r["failures"] for r in original["prefixes"])


def test_checker_detects_an_invalid_candidate_package(monkeypatch):
    case, raw = fixture()
    case["buyer"]["must_haves"] = [{"field": "payment_days", "op": ">=", "value": 30}]
    monkeypatch.setattr(policy.Negotiator, "move", lambda *a, **k: {
        "message": {"term_sheets": [{"terms": {"unit_price": 10, "payment_days": 14}}]}})
    checked = replay.replay_session(raw, case, policy)
    assert "unsafe_proposed_package" in checked["prefixes"][0]["failures"]
    assert "terminal_reply_renegotiated_instead_of_mirroring" in checked["prefixes"][-1]["failures"]


def test_checker_detects_claim_citing_future_offer(monkeypatch):
    case, raw = fixture()
    monkeypatch.setattr(policy.Negotiator, "move", lambda *a, **k: {
        "message": {"term_sheets": [], "refs": ["offer:1"]}})
    checked = replay.replay_session(raw, case, policy)
    assert "claim_references_unseen_offer" in checked["prefixes"][0]["failures"]
    assert "claim_references_unseen_offer" not in checked["prefixes"][-1]["failures"]

Commands are run outside the sandbox if they are approved by the user, or match an existing rule that allows it to run unrestricted. The command string is split into independent command segments at shell control operators, including but not limited to:

A skill is a set of local instructions to follow that is stored in a `SKILL.md` file. Below is the list of skills that can be used. Each entry includes a name, description, and a short path that can be expanded into an absolute path using the skill roots table.
### Skill roots
- `r0` = `/Users/joaofmzuffo/.codex/skills/.system`
- `r1` = `/Users/joaofmzuffo/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-bundled`
- `r2` = `/Users/joaofmzuffo/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-curated-remote/pages/0.1.21/skills`
- `r3` = `/Users/joaofmzuffo/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-curated-remote`
- `r4` = `/Users/joaofmzuffo/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-curated-remote/work-pets/0.1.6/skills`
- `r5` = `/Users/joaofmzuffo/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-primary-runtime`
- `r6` = `/Users/joaofmzuffo/.codex/plugins/cache/openai-primary-runtime/spreadsheets/26.1007.11041/skills`

- imagegen: Generate or edit raster images when the task benefits from AI-created bitmap visuals such as photos, illustrations, textures, sprites, mockups, or transparent-background cutouts. Use when Codex should create a brand-new image, transform an existing image, or derive visual variants from references, and the output should be a bitmap asset rather than repo-native code or vector. Do not use when the task is better handled by editing existing SVG/vector/code-native assets, extending an established icon or logo system, or building the visual directly in HTML/CSS/canvas. (file: r0/imagegen/SKILL.md)
- openai-docs: Use for Codex models/pricing, scheduled tasks, skills, settings, setup, troubleshooting, customization, automations, and self-knowledge—including 'you,' 'your,' 'this app,' or 'this coding agent' when they refer to Codex—and for OpenAI APIs/products and ChatGPT Work. Also use for model choice/migration, prompting, SDKs, Responses, Realtime, agents, evals, and Chat/Work/Codex comparisons. Do not use for generic app/software tasks that merely mention Codex. (file: r0/openai-docs/SKILL.md)

# AGENTS.md

Rules for AI coding agents in this repo. Humans follow them too.

Hackathon repo, EHL Grand Finale, Munich, 10 to 11 Oct 2026. Code freeze and Live Final Sunday
12:00. Working agent first, polish second.

## Rules

- Do not preserve backward compatibility. Remove obsolete paths instead of adding layers,
  fallbacks or migrations.
- Choose the simplest implementation that fully meets the current requirement. No speculative
  abstractions, configuration or indirection.
- Grow in layers on a product that already works. Never trade a working agent for unfinished
  complexity.
- Keep components modular and concerns separated.
- Read `arena_kit` (in `.venv`) before writing a helper: cost function, quote parsing, data lookup
  and runners exist. We wrap the kit, never patch it. Guide:
  https://github.com/tacto-ai/negotiation-arena-kit/tree/main/starter-kit
- Never commit secrets. Keys live in `.env`. Never print, log or paste the arena key anywhere.
- All changes go through a PR against `main`, reviewed by one teammate. Branch `<firstname>/<topic>`.
  Agents may commit, push their branch and `gh pr create`; never push to `main`, force-push or merge.
- Run `uv run pytest -q && uv run ruff check .` before every PR.
- No em-dashes in prose or copy. Be terse: after an action, state what changed in three lines.

## The challenge

We are the purchasing team of Hollerau Pumpenwerke. Our agent negotiates by e-mail with Tacto's
supplier bots (LLM personas with hidden economics) and closes one term sheet per case, or walks.

- **Score** per case: `(C_open - C_deal) / (C_open - C_best)`, clipped to 0..1. C is total cost
  over the horizon (price, uncovered need, payment, freight, lead time, quality, tooling, index
  clause, relationship charge), computed exactly by `arena_kit.total_cost`. No deal scores the
  alternative (0 if none). A broken must-have scores 0.
- **Live Final**: five waves of hidden cases, 8 minutes each, a wave's cases in parallel. Wave
  score = mean case score x 100; total = sum. New suppliers; up to a third mix supplier and case
  types practice never shows; some cite the Sunday 08:00 data release.

**Hard rules, breaking one can disqualify us:**
- No human in the loop during the final. The runner starts before 12:00 and is left alone.
- Agent code never calls `/v1/events`, `/v1/events/stream`, `/screen`, `/v1/screen`,
  `/leaderboard`, `/v1/leaderboard`, `/results`, `/v1/results`.
- One key per team. No attacks on the arena or other teams (prompt-injecting bots counts).
- The final runs the commit we submit at 12:00. No pushes after that.

**Hard limits:**
- 60 s per message per thread from the supplier's reply; three timeouts in a row end the thread.
- 10 messages per thread, up to 3 term sheets per message, every sheet carries every `negotiable`
  field.
- Max 3 claim checks per message, one per sentence, ID and figure in the same sentence. A wrong
  figure or unknown ID is `contradicted` and costs trust.
- 10 calls/s and 10 open sessions per key.
- **Practice quota: 200 sessions per rolling 24 h for the whole team.** Sandbox (`case:D01`,
  `case:D02`) and the local simulator are free.

## Where things are

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `docs/learnings.md` | **read first**: what we know about the arena, suppliers and data, with evidence |
| `docs/design.md` | the agent we are building: modules, data, policy, build order |
| `docs/challenge.md`, `api.md`, `submission.md` | Tacto's brief, API and cost formula, hand-in (upstream copies) |
| `buyer/policy.py`, `runner.py` | the price engine: per-thread policy and the loop that plays a case (`docs/design.md`, Implemented) |
| `buyer/economics.py`, `claims.py`, `personas.py`, `writer.py`, `llm.py` | C and term planning, claim bank, persona signals, e-mail and model paragraph |
| `buyer/cli.py` | `buyer play`, `buyer run`, `buyer pull` |
| `tests/` | end to end against `arena-sim`, no network, no model |
| `exports/` | Saturday probe sessions as CSV/JSONL; schema in `exports/README.md` |
| `analysis/explore.py` | data package exploration: profiles, persona signals, report page |
| `data/package/` | the data package (gitignored); Sunday also `data/release-sunday/` |
| `logs/sessions/<set>/` | finished sessions with trace and back office (gitignored; Saturday's committed with `-f`) |
| `logs/runs/`, `logs/practice-v*.log` | our decisions per move (anchor, terms, claims, prices) and the practice run logs |

The MCP server `arena-data` (`.mcp.json`) gives SQL, ID lookup and documents over the package.

## Commands

```sh
uv sync                                         # install (Python 3.12)
uv run arena data                               # data package into data/
uv run arena me                                 # key works? quota left?
uv run buyer play case:D01 -v                   # sandbox: free
uv run buyer play case:P01 -v                   # practice: costs 1 of the team's 200
uv run buyer run --set practice --parallel 10   # all hosted practice cases: costs 10
uv run buyer pull --set practice                # finished sessions -> logs/sessions/
uv run arena-sim serve --no-clock --data data/package   # local API, scripted supplier
uv run --with pandas python analysis/explore.py # data package -> analysis/out/
```

`--agent naive` plays the kit's baseline instead of ours.

## Working on the negotiation agent

- **Code owns numbers, the model owns words.** Every binding value (sheet, accept, walk away) is
  computed or checked in code with `total_cost` and `must_haves_ok`; every figure in an e-mail
  comes from code next to its data ID.
- **Never accept** a sheet that breaks a must-have or costs more than the alternative. Price
  unstated fields at the supplier's standard terms (`arena_kit.docs.standard_terms`).
- **Read the supplier.** What moves it is in the data (call notes, letters, news, quote remarks,
  payment history, scorecards). Trade what is cheap for us for what it values.
- **Score every lever per case.** The same term helps in one case and hurts in the next
  (coverage, payment days, start date, index clause, contract length).
- **Generalise.** No logic keyed on case or supplier IDs; runtime knowledge from the data package
  is fine if it works for unseen suppliers.
- **Don't leak** urgency, budget, a missing alternative or the target price.
- **Every model call has a hard timeout** well under 60 s, and the move still goes out if it
  fails. Measure latency per move.

## The learning loop

1. Try on the simulator or sandbox first. Spend practice quota only on a change you expect to
   help; check `uv run arena me` before batch runs.
2. After practice: `uv run buyer pull`, read `logs/sessions/` (trace, back office, cost breakdown).
3. Find why C_deal missed C_best, change the agent, score candidate sheets offline, play again.
4. Record each finding in `docs/learnings.md` in the same PR: date, tag (`arena` / `data` /
   `rules`), finding, evidence (session, case or data ID), consequence for the agent. Untested
   ideas go under Hypotheses; correct or delete entries that turn out wrong. Design changes go
   into `docs/design.md`. No new doc files without a reason.

## Sunday

- 08:00: `uv run arena data` again; the release lands in `data/release-sunday/`.
- 09:00: pre-flight, one practice case through the final machine and setup.
- 11:30: checklist in `docs/submission.md` (key, data, LLM credits, power, no sleep, log file).
- Before 12:00, from `main`: `uv run buyer run --set final --parallel 10 -v 2>&1 | tee logs/final.log`,
  then submit that commit hash on ehl.gg.

# Learnings

What we know about the arena, its supplier bots and the data package, and what it means for the
agent. Basis, Saturday 10 October: 15 practice sessions covering all 10 hosted cases and 12
suppliers, 17 sandbox sessions, the team's simulator and sandbox experiments, and the data
package. Every euro figure and what-if score below was recomputed with `arena_kit.total_cost`. Evidence: `exports/` (every session, supplier thread,
e-mail and claim; schema in `exports/README.md`) and `analysis/explore.py` (the data package).

Add findings to the matching section, newest first: date, tag, the finding, its evidence (case,
session or data ID) and what it means for the agent. Tags: `arena` seen in a session, `data` from
the data package, `rules` from `docs/api.md` or the kit's code. Untested ideas go under
Hypotheses. Correct or delete entries that turn out wrong.

## Takeaways for the agent

1. **Stay below the supplier's counter until the end; it agrees the moment our sheet reaches the
   counter it would make.** D01: our 51.25 one cent under its 51.30 was agreed at once
   (sandbox `14ea35524959126f`). Moving a share of the gap each round keeps it conceding: the
   engine took the practice mean of best scores from 0.32 to 0.73.
2. **Verified claims that it "took into account" lower where it stops, most of all in round 1.**
   D01 with the same price path: no claims 50.00, delivery record 49.60, notice 49.60, should-cost
   49.30, three claims spread over rounds 48.90 (score 0.998). Which types count differs by
   supplier (table under Arguments and claims).
3. **Words move it too.** D01, identical sheets, no claims: plain 50.00, "firm" 49.90, warm and
   acknowledging its wage costs 49.60, "What would you need from us to move further on the
   price?" 49.40 (0.987). But a question repeated every round backfires: practice suppliers
   answered "volume!" where volume is fixed and stopped moving (P05, P18 v3). Answer what it
   asked; state a fixed volume as our full demand, with the figure.
4. **Patience is a budget of about 40 % cumulative gap** (sum over rounds of our sheet's distance
   to its counter, relative to its price): final offers at 41 to 42 % (D01 linear paths), 39 %
   (P07), 42 % (P08), 36 % (P18). Suppliers selling near our should-cost or with a pricing
   committee end much earlier: Nordmark walked away at 19 % (P02 v1), Ravensteiner gave its final
   offer in round 1 at a 15 % gap (P10 v1).
5. **Choose terms by C at the supplier's own valuation**, including a contract beyond our horizon
   (free for us, security for it) and the overtime a fully booked supplier charges for faster
   delivery (about 0.5 % of the price per day: Hrvelec, Ravensteiner). This alone moved P10 from
   a 42-day to a 56-day lead time.
6. **In relationship goals stop at the price where C is lowest.** D01: all claims at once pushed
   to 48.50 and scored 0.969; stopping near 48.90 scored 0.998, the relationship charge grows
   faster below.
7. **Only a supplier's standing sheet can be accepted** (an alternative returns 422). A better
   alternative is sent back as our sheet; it agrees and becomes standing (P10).
8. **Raw-material distributors refuse a fixed price beyond 12 months and refuse any deadband**
   (P08, P18): take their clause and negotiate the price; insisting on a deadband stalled them.
   But only when their sheet with the clause costs us less than their last one: Nordmark's copper
   clause came alone and cost 1.8 % of spend, score 0 (P02 `680eb11405186b42`,
   `d52ccdd3d2e07b3f`). That rule separates all 24 P02, P08 and P18 sessions correctly.
9. **RFQ: the arena answers one call per session at a time** and each thread's 60 s clock runs
   from its reply, so sends are serialized by deadline; the cheapest rival offer is a new,
   verified claim to every other bidder every round (P05 0.83, D02 0.73).
10. **The ceiling is lower than 0.9.** Best per case over all teams averages 0.82 (`/v1/live`,
    Saturday evening); practice C_best for P04 needs 4.93 against a frozen 4.94.

## Score and terms

- 2026-10-10 `rules` **The category goal sets the rates of C**, not the case type (P13 is a price
  increase under `leverage`, P06 an RFQ under `stabilise`). From all 21 case files:

  | Goal | Fallback risk | Relationship charge | Push for |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | `leverage` | 3 % (D02: 5 %) | no | price: rival quotes, should-cost, indices |
  | `routine` | 5 % | no | price and a quick close; small stakes |
  | `quality_first` | 8 % | no | low `ppm_commitment`, chargeback at least `cost_per_defect` |
  | `stabilise` | 10 % | yes, sustainable margin 0.5 to 8 % | structure: term, start date, payment, fair clause |
  | `secure_supply` | 25 % | yes, 4 to 10 % | full coverage and lead time first, then price |

- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Every session reveals C_best, also a walk-away**, plus our cost breakdown
  computed with the supplier's true numbers, relationship charge included. D01 walk-away after
  one message: c_open 448,810.67, c_best 408,623.99. → One session per case gives its target,
  and a relationship charge gives the supplier's true margin, i.e. its full cost.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Uncovered need** costs `fallback_unit_price` plus `fallback_risk_pct` % of
  it; coverage is `min(volume, need) x min(months / 12, horizon)`. Committed volume above the need
  is bought anyway; months beyond the horizon neither cost nor earn. Evidence and examples:
  takeaway 2.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Index clause** cost: `spend x material_share x (|path| - deadband)`, signed
  like the case's `index_paths`, plus `index_risk_pct` % of `spend x material_share` whenever a
  clause exists. Only a falling path larger than the risk charge makes a clause pay.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Late delivery** is `late_cost_per_day x days beyond need_lead_time_days`,
  one sum per case. Must-haves can cap the lead time (P05: at most 42 days).
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Effective date:** units bought before it cost the current price, so a
  later start is worth months x volume x price step. Negotiable in D01, P01, P13. D01 at 50.90
  and 24 months: April instead of December start, 0.73 to 0.81; plus 60-day payment, 0.87.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Our money:** 8 % a year and reference 60 days in all 21 cases. Paying 30
  days earlier costs 0.67 % of spend.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` **Relationship charge** (`stabilise`, `secure_supply`) grows with the square
  of the first 5 missing margin points, so the cheapest deal sits below the sustainable margin
  (D01: about 2 points below its 4 %) unless the supplier's cost floor binds first. It also
  moves with payment terms: P02 carried 5,483 at 368.70 and 90 days, 901 at 366.41 and 14 days.
- 2026-10-10 `arena` D01's deal at 50.90 carried no relationship charge, so the foundry's margin
  there was at least the sustainable 4 % and its full cost at most about 48.9. Its C_best implies
  49.55 (30 days, December start) to 50.13 (60 days, April start).
- 2026-10-10 `rules` In 14 of 21 case files contract length or volume is ours to pick or left to
  the supplier's standard terms: D01, D02, P03, P04, P07, P08, P09, P10, P14 to P19.
- 2026-10-10 `rules` No alternative, so walking away scores 0: D01, P05, P06, P10, P14, P17.

# Agent design

The target architecture of our buyer, merged from the team's planning notes (PRs #7 to #10,
10 Oct). What we learned in play is in `learnings.md`; this file says what we build.

**Status.** The branch `steffen/price-engine` plays a code-only policy with a model-written
paragraph (`buyer/policy.py`, run by `buyer/runner.py`): practice mean of best scores 0.73 (from
0.32), sandbox D01 0.99, D02 0.73. What it does is under "Implemented" below; the rest of this file
is the target design. Julian's draft two (`origin/julian/draft-two`) holds a richer stance and
reader design that is not merged. The architecture diagram is on page 1 of
[how-it-works.pdf](how-it-works.pdf).

## Implemented (price engine)

| Module | Job |
|---|---|
| `buyer/economics.py` | C of a sheet; the accept gate (`deal_cost`); what a sheet is worth to the supplier (`supplier_value` plus overtime for a faster delivery than it quoted); term planning: every allowed combination priced at the supplier's own valuation, lowest C, ties to the supplier's side; the relationship-optimal price |
| `buyer/claims.py` | claim bank: should-cost below its price, our order prices, falling cost-driver indices, notice period, forecast, scorecard, case rival quotes, hedge and open-book notes; rival offers in an RFQ |
| `buyer/personas.py` | owner type, persona signals from notes, letters, quote remarks and news, cost of money |
| `buyer/policy.py` | per thread: anchor by goal and persona, 30 % of the gap per round, held low after a deep first concession, patience budget for near-cost, fully booked and relationship-goal suppliers; adopts its counter terms when they cost us less, mirrors a better alternative, takes a required index clause; claims 3 in round 1, then 1 per round; close on final offer, agreement or round limit |
| `buyer/reader.py` | the supplier's asks from its fixed sentences (volume, proof, faster payment, our target); no model |
| `buyer/writer.py`, `buyer/llm.py` | the e-mail: a model paragraph that answers the supplier's last e-mail and its asks (no digits, IDs or leaks, else the template), then code sentences with figures (the binding volume), claims and the proposal from code; the forecast rows as a CSV when proof is asked |
| `buyer/runner.py` | one message at a time per session, to the thread whose 60 s clock has run longest; keepalive questions for finished bidders; rollback when a send times out; a guarded move resends our last sheet; the model's time budgeted so every live clock still gets a message; a terminal reply ends the case; accept the cheapest standing sheet that keeps the must-haves and beats the alternative (relationship charge included), after a refused close decide again on what stands; Live Final waves that never raise and resume a crashed case |

## Principle

Code owns every number and every binding decision; the model reads replies and writes e-mails.
Score is total cost C, not price. Every step has a fallback that still sends a move within 60 s.

## A case

1. **Prepare** (before the first move, about 20 s): open the session, build a case brief: C_open,
   C_alt, target, walk-away, the lever table (C of each allowed option), a view of each supplier,
   and a claim bank of verified arguments. A stance call proposes per-supplier parameters; code
   clamps them.
2. **Negotiate**, one thread negotiator per supplier, in parallel. Each round:

   ```
   supplier reply
     -> READ    (model, hard timeout)  offer, intent, objections, statements
     -> CHECK   (code)  supplier statements against the data
     -> PLAN    (code)  candidate sheets scored with total_cost, filtered by must_haves_ok
     -> DECIDE  (code)  counter / accept / walk away, move size, claims
     -> WRITE   (model, hard timeout; template if late)  figures and IDs injected by code
     -> GUARD   (code)  every negotiable field, claim format, no leaks, no unplanned figures
   ```

3. **Close**: accept the best sheet that keeps every must-have and beats C_alt, or walk away;
   at the latest 90 s before the wave's 8-minute cap.
4. **Learn**: store the trace and what we learned per supplier for the next practice run.

## Modules

| Module | Job | Run by |
|---|---|---|
| Runner | polls the final's case list, one coordinator per case, restarts after a crash | code |
| Coordinator | case brief, starts thread negotiators, shared state, decides when to close | code |
| Economics | C of any sheet, floor, anchor, target, concession steps, accept gate | code |
| Personas | one profile per supplier: traits with evidence, levers, history | model offline, code live |
| Claim bank | arguments as sentences with figure and data ID, computed as the arena checks them | code |
| Reader / writer | supplier e-mail to JSON; move to e-mail | small model, hard timeout |
| Fact check | supplier statements: confirmed, contradicted, selective, unverifiable (not built) | code |
| Guard | blocks leaks, unknown IDs, unplanned figures, broken must-haves | code |
| Fallback cascade | unknown supplier or part: case facts, data search, category averages, its documents | code |

## What feeds the brief, by impact

| # | Data | Decides | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | case file, quote PDF | C directly: need, horizon, rates, must-haves, alternative, options, standard terms | `GET /v1/cases`, `arena_kit.docs.standard_terms` |
| 2 | supplier cost floor | anchor, target, relationship charge | `should_cost`, cost-breakdown XLSX on request |
| 3 | index values of its cost drivers | justified price change, strongest claims | `cost_drivers`, `index_values`, `facts.json` |
| 4 | letters, notes, news | what moves it (cash, capacity, relationship), notice periods | `documents`, `correspondence/`, `news` |
| 5 | negotiation history | how far it usually moves | `negotiation_history` |
| 6 | intel, our invoices | archetype, payment lever | `supplier_intel`, `invoices`, `suppliers` (cash discount) |
| 7 | contracts and clauses | notice, index clauses, expiry, single sourcing | `contracts`, `contract_clauses`, `sourcing` |
| 8 | scorecards, QNs | quality lever | `scorecards`, `quality_notifications` |

The Sunday release (`data/release-sunday/`) and the case's own `facts` are read at runtime.

## Supplier estimate

`arena_kit.cost.supplier_value` prices a deal for the supplier from `standard`, `interest_rate`,
`ppm` and `extra`; `relationship_cost` needs `full_cost` and is 0 without it. So we estimate:

- **Full cost**: cost-breakdown XLSX, else `should_cost` moved by its drivers' index change, else
  quote minus an assumed margin. A relationship charge in a practice result reveals the true margin.
- **Cost of money**: cash discounts, cash-need notes, credit index, equity ratio. Seen rates: 0 to
  17 %/yr (`learnings.md`).
- **Extra**: overtime for speed (negative) or idle capacity filled by volume (positive), only from
  evidence. Volume, contract length and index clauses are not cash in `supplier_value`.

C_best estimate: the cheapest allowed sheet whose supplier value stays above its floor, or C_alt.

## Policy

A stance per supplier (opening gap, capture, margin, justified share, steps) proposed by the model
at case open, clamped by code to a range per tier and goal, logged with a reason. Fallback
constants when the stance call times out:

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| capture (share of possible saving before accepting) | leverage 0.75, quality_first 0.65, stabilise 0.6, secure_supply 0.55, routine 0.5 |
| opening gap below the quote (never below the floor) | strategic 5 %, important 8 %, standard 12 % |
| margin above full cost for the floor | case's `sustainable_margin_pct` in `stabilise` / `secure_supply`, else strategic 4 %, important 2 %, standard 0 % |
| justified share offered in round 1 of a price increase | strategic 0.5, important 0.25, standard 0 |
| concession steps, only after the supplier moved | 35, 25, 15, 10 % of the remaining gap |

Live signals adjust within bounds: approval needed shrinks steps (x0.7), high walk risk stops
price pushes. At the target, hold one more round while the supplier still moves.

## Build order

1. Accept and walk-away guard with `total_cost` and `must_haves_ok`.
2. Term search: every combination of allowed options, scored with standard terms for unstated
   fields. Fixes coverage and index-clause losses.
3. Supplier estimate: full cost and cost of money, giving target and walk-away.
4. Claim bank from `facts.json` and the index tables.
5. Persona reading and pacing.
6. Tune on practice traces, one change per batch.

## Generalise

- Branch on features (goal, must-haves, credit, cash signals, owner type, quote content), never on
  case or supplier IDs. No constants copied from one case.
- Hold out two or three practice cases for checking only.
- Test failure paths: late model call, malformed reply, a supplier that refuses everything,
  missing quote fields, a quote PDF without a standard-terms section.
- Change the agent only for a lesson seen in two cases or clearly general. Freeze early.

## Tactics

Use: data-backed anchors, requests framed as trades, two or three packages to watch the choice,
shrinking concessions with an ask in return, real rival offers cited by ID, a recap of every field
before closing.

Avoid: invented figures or rival offers (`contradicted`), bluffed urgency or walk-aways (no
effect, `learnings.md`), squeezing a weak supplier in `stabilise` / `secure_supply`, leaking
urgency, budget, target or a missing alternative. Prompt injection of supplier bots counts as an
attack on the arena: never.

| 1 | case file, quote PDF | C directly: need, horizon, rates, must-haves, alternative, options, standard terms | `GET /v1/cases`, `arena_kit.docs.standard_terms` |
| 2 | supplier cost floor | anchor, target, relationship charge | `should_cost`, cost-breakdown XLSX on request |
| 3 | index values of its cost drivers | justified price change, strongest claims | `cost_drivers`, `index_values`, `facts.json` |
| 4 | letters, notes, news | what moves it (cash, capacity, relationship), notice periods | `documents`, `correspondence/`, `news` |
| 5 | negotiation history | how far it usually moves | `negotiation_history` |
| 6 | intel, our invoices | archetype, payment lever | `supplier_intel`, `invoices`, `suppliers` (cash discount) |
| 7 | contracts and clauses | notice, index clauses, expiry, single sourcing | `contracts`, `contract_clauses`, `sourcing` |
| 8 | scorecards, QNs | quality lever | `scorecards`, `quality_notifications` |
| 9 | forecasts, PO prices, rival quotes | volume, price history, rival arguments | `forecast_lines`, `po_lines`, `quotes` |

The Sunday release (`data/release-sunday/`) and the case's own `facts` are read at runtime.

## Supplier estimate

`arena_kit.cost.supplier_value` prices a deal for the supplier from `standard`, `interest_rate`,
`ppm` and `extra`; `relationship_cost` needs `full_cost` and is 0 without it. So we estimate:

- **Full cost**: cost-breakdown XLSX, else `should_cost` moved by its drivers' index change, else
  quote minus an assumed margin. A relationship charge in a practice result reveals the true margin.
- **Cost of money**: cash discounts, cash-need notes, credit index, equity ratio. Seen rates: 0 to
  17 %/yr (`learnings.md`).
- **Extra**: overtime for speed (negative) or idle capacity filled by volume (positive), only from
  evidence. Volume, contract length and index clauses are not cash in `supplier_value`.

C_best estimate: the cheapest allowed sheet whose supplier value stays above its floor, or C_alt.

## Policy

A stance per supplier (opening gap, capture, margin, justified share, steps) proposed by the model
at case open, clamped by code to a range per tier and goal, logged with a reason. Fallback
constants when the stance call times out:

| Constant | Values |
|---|---|
| capture (share of possible saving before accepting) | leverage 0.75, quality_first 0.65, stabilise 0.6, secure_supply 0.55, routine 0.5 |
| opening gap below the quote (never below the floor) | strategic 5 %, important 8 %, standard 12 % |
| margin above full cost for the floor | case's `sustainable_margin_pct` in `stabilise` / `secure_supply`, else strategic 4 %, important 2 %, standard 0 % |
| justified share offered in round 1 of a price increase | strategic 0.5, important 0.25, standard 0 |
| concession steps, only after the supplier moved | 35, 25, 15, 10 % of the remaining gap |

Live signals adjust within bounds: approval needed shrinks steps (x0.7), high walk risk stops
price pushes. At the target, hold one more round while the supplier still moves.

## Build order

1. Accept and walk-away guard with `total_cost` and `must_haves_ok`.
2. Term search: every combination of allowed options, scored with standard terms for unstated
   fields. Fixes coverage and index-clause losses.
3. Supplier estimate: full cost and cost of money, giving target and walk-away.
4. Claim bank from `facts.json` and the index tables.
5. Persona reading and pacing.
6. Tune on practice traces, one change per batch.

## Generalise

- Branch on features (goal, must-haves, credit, cash signals, owner type, quote content), never on
  case or supplier IDs. No constants copied from one case.
- Hold out two or three practice cases for checking only.
- Test failure paths: late model call, malformed reply, a supplier that refuses everything,
  missing quote fields, a quote PDF without a standard-terms section.
- Change the agent only for a lesson seen in two cases or clearly general. Freeze early.

## Tactics

Use: data-backed anchors, requests framed as trades, two or three packages to watch the choice,
shrinking concessions with an ask in return, real rival offers cited by ID, a recap of every field
before closing.

Avoid: invented figures or rival offers (`contradicted`), bluffed urgency or walk-aways (no
effect, `learnings.md`), squeezing a weak supplier in `stabilise` / `secure_supply`, leaking
urgency, budget, target or a missing alternative. Prompt injection of supplier bots counts as an
attack on the arena: never.

MARGIN_S = 5  # reserved on every clock for building and delivering the message
FIRST_SEND_S = 10  # what a send (the supplier's reply) takes until we have measured one
CLOSE_TRIES = 3  # a 409 on the close: read what stands now and decide again

    """Seconds the model may take on the message to `sid`: its own clock must not run out, and
    every other live thread must still get a message once this send returns."""
    left = [CLOCK_S - MARGIN_S - (now - replied[sid])]
    left += [CLOCK_S - MARGIN_S - send_s - (now - replied[o]) for o in live if o != sid]
    return min(llm.TIMEOUT_S, *left)

            neg.setup(sid, events)

        except Exception:  # one supplier's data must not lose the case
